messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - prod-canary: sudden spike in 500s and 502s from redwood-inference-canary. 5 pods OOMKilled within 4m after feature flag flip 'compact-cache' -> 'on'. investigating.
alice: oncall-ryan can you take? paging now.
oncall-ryan: taking it. looking at logs.
ben: seeing a bunch of evictions + oom_kill in kubelet logs, pods show OOMKilled. sample:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n prod | grep inference
redwood-inference-canary-5f6d7   0/2   OOMKilled   0     2m
redwood-inference-canary-6a7b8   1/2   Running     0     3m
``` 
ben: also pulled container logs, memory spike right after startup of new sidecar v2 (telemetry):
```text
telemetry-init: allocated 1.6Gi
inference: oom killed at 1.5Gi
``` 
miriam: that telemetry sidecar was introduced in the release manifest for canary to buffer metrics. looks like it has a memory leak under load.
alice: can we flip the flag back to stop canary traffic hitting that codepath? which flag service do we hit?
ben: it's feature-service internal: `compact-cache` toggles new cache packing + sidecar path. flipping should route canary to old path.
oncall-ryan: issuing kill-switch to feature-service now.
eng-ops: FYI issuing controlled rollback of feature flag and draining affected pods.
eng-ops: command run:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://flags.internal/compact-cache -H "Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>" -d '{"enabled":false}'
kubectl rollout restart deployment/redwood-inference-canary -n prod
``` 
miriam: flag toggle accepted, routing back to v1. starting restart of canary pods.
ben: watching pod events: new pods coming up without sidecar. old OOM pods are terminating.
oncall-ryan: confirming reduction in 5xxs in API gateway - error rate down from 86% -> 6% in last 2 min :thumbsup:
alice: good. customer-impact: spike affected ~18% of API requests for ~6m. no confirmed data leakage, only transient errors. opening incident ticket.
incident-bot: Pager duty: escalation to SRE lead if not resolved in 15m.
eng-ops: follow-up notes — root cause looks like telemetry sidecar misconfigured memoryRequests (missing limit) + HPA reaction: HPA scaled to zero minReplicas in canary inadvertently, causing restart surge. we'll capture exact manifest diff.
miriam: creating PR to revert sidecar change and add memory limits. linking: https://git.internal/r/redwood/inference/merge/2345
ben: adding smoke test to deploy pipeline to simulate telemetry buffer under 60s load.
oncall-ryan: handing off to alice for postmortem and customer comms. I'll stay available for 30m if anything flares.
alice: acknowledged. will write summary, impact, and remediation. tagging #all-hands if customer escalates. :white_check_mark:
eng-ops: resolved flag reverted and canary rolled back at 2024-03-18T21:12:40Z (approx). monitoring for 30m.
alice: postmortem owner assigned. next steps: revert PR, add resource limits, add canary smoke test, and update runbook for feature flag kill-switch steps.
incident-bot: Incident P1 -> mitigated. please complete postmortem within 72h.
